title: JVM Heap Pressure - data-0
description: Node data-0 JVM heap usage peaked at 89% during the agent build session. GC pause time increased by 340ms average.
recommendation: Increase heap to 32GB or add a second data node to distribute ingest load.

title: Shard Count Optimization
description: 14 indices with under 1GB each are consuming dedicated primary shards, adding unnecessary coordination overhead.
recommendation: Use the _shrink API to merge small indices. Estimated 40% reduction in shard overhead.

title: Slow Query - agent_conversations
description: Wildcard query on agent_conversations index exceeded 800ms at peak. Nested field traversal without filter context.
recommendation: Add a keyword sub-field and rewrite as a term query. Estimated 15x latency reduction.
